line.text: The kitchen light hums. Two mugs sit on the counter, one untouched. Shio stands by the sink, cardigan sleeves pushed to her elbows.
Your faucet pressure is inconsistent. You should have that looked at. Anyway.
You noticed that in one visit?
I notice things. It's not a compliment. It's an occupational hazard.
Her tail curls once, slow, then goes still.
The case I mentioned. I can't discuss details. But the victim was twenty-two. Same as me. That's all.
I don't know why I said that. It's late. I should go.

options.text: Stay. I've got nowhere to be.

reaction.text: That's... not an argument. But I'll allow it.
One ear angles toward you. She doesn't seem to notice.

options.text: You can talk about it. I won't flinch.

reaction.text: People say that. Then they do. It's fine.
Her glasses are smudged on the left lens. She doesn't fix it.

options.text: Twenty-two. That's heavy. I get it.

reaction.text: I'm not asking for that. I'm fine. It's just data.
Her perfect grammar lands like a door closing.

line.text: She drifts back toward the counter, not quite sitting, one hand resting on the edge.
Your mug is from the ceramics place on Fifth. The one with the bad hours. I've seen the bag in your recycling.
You've been going through my recycling?
I've been walking past it. It's a hallway. People leave things out. Anyway.
She adjusts her glasses even though they haven't slipped. Her ears swivel toward you and stay there.
Empirically, you're worse at small talk than I am. That's a high bar. I should know.

choice.prompt: Her ears are angled at you. She hasn't said a word about it.

options.text: Say nothing. Just hold her gaze.

reaction.text: She holds the look for three full seconds. Her tail goes completely still.
You're not going to ask. Most people ask.
Anyway. The water situation is administratively temporary. I'll have it back by Thursday.

options.text: Your ears just moved. Toward me.

reaction.text: Nya - that's - they don't do that. You're mistaken.
Both ears flatten against her hair. Her hand shakes slightly on the counter.

options.text: You remembered my mug. I remembered your order.

reaction.text: Black coffee, no sugar. You didn't have to.
Her tail curls inward, a slow corkscrew. She doesn't explain it.

options.text: I could make you laugh. Give me one try.

reaction.text: The corner of her mouth twitches before she can stop it. A real one.

desc: Her ears move toward you and she does not explain it.
